evidence.description: FIND-009 closed: dead `if False else` branch removed; clean if/elif handling jpy_int and usdc_float_6dp.
FIND-013 closed: docstring now states `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_\-]{3,}$` matching the regex on line 16.
FIND-001 closed at file-count level: 8 .sh + 1 .py exist (REQ-A/B/D/E/F entry points).
FIND-002/003/006/015/017 carried into scope-cut table with concrete sprint-2 commitments.

FIND-018 narrowed to `--label\s*[=]?\s*['\"]?escalation['\"]?` — catches `--label escalation` and `--label=escalation`, but a list-literal form (`["--label", "escalation"]`) where the comma/quote separator sits between the two tokens still bypasses; finding not fully closed.
Shared helpers (is_verdict_pass, sha256_file, append_jsonl) now used by mutation_gate (FIND-016 fix), proposal_loop, deliverable_loop, spawn_pin.
Layered split: lib/*.py (pure + small I/O units) vs *.sh (launchd-facing glue) is preserved; no duplication of dispatch logic across files.
FIND-015 (real ed25519) explicitly scope-deferred with file-paths and acceptance criteria (replace sha256-mix with nacl.signing; ship anicca-bot real keypair in CI secret).
